meta.name: azure-playwright-migration-skill
meta.description: Migrate test automation from Azure Playwright Workspaces / Microsoft Playwright Testing to TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) in any language or framework. Covers playwright.service.config.ts with @azure/playwright createAzurePlaywrightConfig (or the retired @azure/microsoft-playwright- testing getServiceConfig), PLAYWRIGHT_SERVICE_URL, Entra ID or access-token auth, exposeNetwork, the Azure reporter. Use this whenever someone wants to move, switch, port, migrate or point tests from Azure Playwright Workspaces to TestMu AI or LambdaTest, asks what the TestMu or LT:Options equivalent is for a capability, config, CLI flag or API from Azure Playwright Workspaces, mentions playwright.service.config, @azure/playwright, createAzurePlaywrightConfig, @azure/microsoft-playwright-testing, getServiceConfig, PLAYWRIGHT_SERVICE_URL, PLAYWRIGHT_SERVICE_ACCESS_TOKEN, ServiceOS, or wants a migration plan, estimate, PR or checklist for a repo currently on Azure Playwright Workspaces, even without the word migrate.
